product_name_specific: RAM: 1500 Pickup, 2500 Pickup, 3500 Pickup, 3500 10K LB Cab, RAM Truck
risk_description: The side airbag inflatable curtain inflator may break due to internal corrosion and may deploy spontaneously in the absence of an accident or commanded deployment. As a result, the metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing injury to the occupants.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
